description: The envelope of every event on the Bus: CloudEvents 1.0 in structured mode, JSON (architecture §3.8.1, implementation §1.2.1). The data is validated against data.schema.json and, on a fixed-convention topic, against its own schema.

id.description: Unique UUID of the event. It is also the Nats-Msg-Id the stream deduplicates by.

type.description: One of the closed types of architecture §3.8.2.

source.description: Identifier of the emitting node, declared by whoever publishes; never read to decide an admission (architecture §3.8.1).

subject.description: The TaskID the event belongs to; in a notice, the resource it talks about (architecture §3.8.1).

traceparent.description: W3C Trace Context. Present in every task.* event and in trace-scope notices; absent in network-scope notices (architecture §3.8.1).

configversion.description: config_version of architecture §3.8.1, spelled as a CloudEvents extension attribute (implementation §1.2.1). Present exactly when traceparent is.
